tool_input.new_string:
0. **Check what's already released FIRST**: `git tag` / `gh release list`. The current `__version__` may already be tagged+published (it was for 2.2.0 → had to bump to 2.2.1). Also check `CHANGELOG.md`'s `[Unreleased]` — shipping PRs often forget to add entries (empty for #96/#99), so you must populate it before tagging.
1. **Branch**: `git checkout -b chore/release-v<X.Y.Z> main`
2. **Bump version**: edit `src/txt2tex/__version__.py` (pyproject uses `dynamic=["version"]` via `[tool.hatch.version] path`, so this one file drives it — no pyproject edit).
3. **Update CHANGELOG.md**: add `## [X.Y.Z] - <date>` under `[Unreleased]`, Keep-a-Changelog Added/Changed/Fixed.
4. **Regenerate version-embedding example assets — via the CLI, NEVER sed** (batch source edits are banned). Only the ~10 *titled* examples embed the version (`\hypersetup{...pdfcreator=txt2tex vX.Y.Z}`; find with `grep -rl "pdfcreator=.*v<OLD>" examples --include='*.tex'`). Run full `uv run txt2tex <file>` on each (rebuilds `.tex` AND `.pdf`). Non-titled examples don't embed the version. Delegate to adb.
5. **`make check`** + **`make fuzz-check`** (160/160) — must pass.
6. **Commit, push, PR, merge** (standard bot-review loop; the release PR is small enough Copilot reviews it).
7. **GitHub release**: `gh release create v<X.Y.Z> --target main --title "v<X.Y.Z>" --notes "..."` (creates the tag).
8. **Build**: `make clean` then `make build` (= `uv build` + `uvx twine check dist/*`; NOT `python -m build`). Confirm `dist/` holds ONLY the new version's wheel+sdist before uploading.
9. **Publish to PyPI**: `uvx twine upload dist/*` — credentials in `~/.pypirc`.
10. **Verify**: `curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/txt2tex/<X.Y.Z>/json` (allow ~30-60s CDN propagation lag before it shows). Delete release branch local+remote; the live session `audit.jsonl` blocks `git checkout main` — stash it, switch, pop.

**Why:** `uv build` is the project's build tool (Makefile). `twine` is invoked via `uvx`, not installed into the venv. `2.2.1` (2026-07-11) followed this corrected flow.
